target_content.meaning: A role of an agent that receives the shipment of the procurement and takes possession, often on behalf of the customer.

mapping.source_evidence: "A Role of an Agent that receives the Shipment of the Procurement ... and who is taking possession."
mapping.rationale: Directly mapped from the source class using its definition as the class meaning.

definitions: A Role of an Agent that receives the Shipment of the Procurement (service, goods or works) and who is taking possession. Additional information: The Role is carried out by the Customer or on behalf of the Customer. The possession of the goods does not necessary imply ownership. The Consignee may be the end-user or the beneficiary. (Consignee) Definition from PEPPOL Despatch: The Consignee is the person or Organisation to which the products will be shipped and who is taking possession. The Role is carried out by the Customer or on behalf of the Customer.

items.reviewer_note: Meaning condenses the source definition (receives the shipment, takes possession, on behalf of the customer). Nothing added.

mapping.source_evidence: "Relation indicating that the instance of the concept has a Price."

definitions: Details concerning a given unit of goods, services or works requested in the Order. Additional information: In general, an Order Line contains the Quantity and Price of the goods, services and goods requested in the Order. However, in certain cases, the Price may not be known, as the Price may fluctuate from one day to the other.
Relation indicating that the instance of the concept has a Price.

items.reviewer_note: hasPrice has rdfs:domain OrderLine and range Price (an ePO-core class outside this module). Flattened to a number with unit 'monetary value': the same accepted simplification of a structured value as fibo-loans/iof-supply-chain. The class definition itself says an order line contains quantity and price.

mapping.source_evidence: Standard domain practice for included concepts OrderResponseInformation, TaxInformation, and AllowanceInformation is that when response pricing is qualified by allowances, accompanying tax information is typically recorded for financial interpretation.
mapping.rationale: This is a standard operational consistency rule grounded in the included pricing-related concepts.

items.reviewer_note: Accepted, flagged. Both conditions use links the source really has on OrderResponseInformation (hasTaxInformation and hasAllowanceInformation, restriction-grounded in eOrdering_restrictions.ttl). The normative part (tax details expected when allowances qualify the pricing) is cited as standard domain practice at medium confidence, not source text: the same disclosed standard-practice category accepted in iof-supply-chain round 2 (S8). Semantic judges: 4/5 supported (eval round 1), not contested in the final evaluation.

rounds.correction: Corrected 2026-11-04 (after the runs, without changing the gold). The round-1 note called both conditions of this rule restriction-grounded. That is false: hasTaxInformation's domain is an owl:unionOf that does not include OrderResponseInformation, and no source property links OrderResponseInformation to AllowanceInformation. Found by expanding the source's unionOf domains (extract.py passes them on only as opaque blank-node ids). The rule was dropped and both links were replaced in repair round 2; the round-2 gold, against which every run was scored, no longer contains them. Relationship indices in this round refer to the round-1 candidate.
